units: <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 2:17:1">Cant. R. to II, 17</cite> <he>לֵילָן של מלכיות</he> the misery (of exile) under the governments; <he>לילן של מצוים</he> the sufferings in Egypt; v. <cite ref="Q00613"><he>פִּיחָה</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Taanit 1:1:17">Y. Taan. I, 64ᵃ</cite> top, v. <cite ref="B01138"><he>בֹּקֶר</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Berakhot 3a:12">Ber. 3ᵃ</cite> <he>ג׳ משמרות הוי הל׳</he> the night is divided into three watches.
<cite ref="Mishnah Zevachim 5:3">Zeb. V, 3</cite> <he>ליום וָלַ׳ וכ׳</he> the same day and the night following to midnight.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 96a:13">Snh. 96ᵃ</cite> <he>שנעשה עמו מעשה ל׳</he> Ms. M. (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l.) night-work was done for him (the stars helping, v.
Jud. V, 20); a. v. fr.—Pl. לֵילוֹת, constr. לֵילֵי (also used as a sing.: night-time, v. next w.).
<cite ref="Mishnah Berakhot 1:5">Ber. I, 5</cite> <he>בַּלֵּ׳</he> at night (in the night prayer).

<cite ref="Taanit 23a:1">Taan. 23ᵃ</cite> <he>בל׳ רביעיות ובל׳ שבתות</he> (not <cite ref="T00107"><he>רביעית</he></cite>) in the nights of Wednesdays and Sabbaths. Sifra <cite ref="Leviticus 1:17">B’ḥuck. ch. I</cite> <he>מל׳ שבת לל׳ שבת</he> every Sabbath night; <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 35:4">Lev. R. s. 35</cite> <he>בל׳ שבתות</he>.
<cite ref="Pesachim 71a:2">Pes. 71ᵃ</cite> <he>ל׳ יו״ט האחרון</he> the night of the last (eighth) day of the festival; <cite ref="Sukkah 48a:6">Succ. 48ᵃ</cite>; a. fr.

senses.gloss: pr. n. Laylah (ref. to Job III, 3), name of the angel of night and of conception.
